name: Nothing Off the Record
description: A four-round, advanced organizational-behaviour simulation on feedback, voice and transparency. Ridgeline Freight Systems, a fictional Pittsburgh B2B software company with 640 employees, has just lost USD 6.4M in annual revenue after a launch failure that 14 people saw coming and only 2 escalated. The founder-CEO announces radical transparency in 90 days: every meeting recorded, real-time peer ratings of traits, believability-weighted votes and open performance data. Playing his Chief of Staff, students (1) weigh the causes of the silence against an evidence file and pick the one metric the programme will answer to; (2) set six design dials (recording, rating visibility, what gets rated, decision rights, information openness, rollout scope) plus training and consent, inside a USD 1.2M budget; (3) handle what six weeks brought: engineers moving disagreement to private messages, a data-backed bias complaint about the ratings, and a legal letter from a carrier recorded without consent; and (4) recommend to the board whether to scale, extend in stages, hold or stop, with zones of privacy, rating governance, a hiring policy and a stop condition. The founder pre-fills his own plan in every round, and it looks best at week 2: on-record activity jumps while the safety survey and resignations lag. The model then shows the transparency paradox, the cost of rating people instead of ideas, believability weighting without a track record and change by fiat. Each round students seal a forecast that is opened later; the score combines outcomes (risks that reach a decision-maker, psychological safety, regretted attrition, legal exposure, founder backing) with process (diagnosis, metric choice, forecast calibration, governance). The debrief computes the decision that cost most, names the mistakes made in this run, reports the five learning objectives as met or not, and gives three questions for class. Built on Dalio, Kegan and Lahey, Bernstein, Edmondson, Morrison and Milliken, Detert and Edmondson, and Kluger and DeNisi. English and Spanish.
view:
Ridgeline Freight Systems · Office of the CEO Internal · Not for distribution

Nothing Off the Record

The founder wants radical transparency in 90 days. You are his Chief of Staff, and you own the rollout.

Round 1 of 4
  1. 1Diagnose
  2. 2Design
  3. 3Stress-test
  4. 4Board review
What this simulation trains
  1. Diagnose silence. Treat organizational silence as a product of climate and structure, not of individual courage.
  2. Process before people. Tell transparency of process and information apart from transparency of people, and know when each helps or harms.
  3. Design for the paradox. Use zones of privacy so that observation raises candour instead of driving it underground.
  4. Make feedback fair. Build peer feedback and decision weighting with calibration, a bias audit and an appeal route.
  5. Speak up to power. Give a founder an evidence-based recommendation he does not want to hear.

Four rounds, about 40 minutes. Each round you decide, seal a forecast, and read what happened. Some consequences arrive one or two rounds later, as they would at a real company.

The fourteen

Risks that reach a decision-maker

Regretted attrition (annualised)
Legal and reputational exposure

Ridgeline, Quaybook and the rules of this simulation

Why did fourteen people stay quiet?

The evidence file

  1. Post-mortem 14 people saw the risk in test data, sprint reviews or customer tickets. 11 of them described the double-booking defect correctly, in writing, in their own team channels.
  2. Engineer, Payments “I raised it in our sprint review. My lead said it was the release team’s call. I didn’t know who on the release team to tell.”
  3. Support lead “The last person who questioned a launch date at the all-hands got a ‘let’s take that offline’ and was moved off the project a month later.”
  4. QA analyst “I flagged it twice in our channel. Nobody upstream reads our channel.”
  5. Senior engineer “Was I scared? Not really. I just didn’t think saying it again would change anything.”
  6. Survey and records 49/100 on “I can raise a problem without fear” (sector benchmark about 70). 18% have ever disagreed with a VP in a meeting. Launch go/no-go meetings keep no written record of objections.
  7. Wes Halloran, all-hands “Fourteen people knew. We don’t have a process problem. We have a courage problem.”
Weigh the causes: split 100 points by how much each one explains the silence

Wes has pre-filled his reading. Change it if the evidence says otherwise. Steps of 5.

0 means no stop condition, which is Wes’s position. The pulse survey moves about ±3 points from noise alone.

Seal a forecast

Write it before you see the result. It is opened later, next to what really happened, and your calibration counts in the process score.

Round by round

summary.en: As chief of staff at Ridgeline Freight Systems, a 640-person B2B software firm in Pittsburgh, you design the CEO's radical transparency plan after a failed launch that 14 people saw coming and only 2 escalated, then advise the board whether to scale or stop it.
summary.es: Como jefa de gabinete de Ridgeline Freight Systems, una empresa de software B2B de Pittsburgh con 640 empleados, diseñas el plan de transparencia radical del CEO tras un lanzamiento fallido que 14 personas vieron venir y solo 2 elevaron, y recomiendas al consejo si ampliarlo o pararlo.

text.en: Diagnose organisational silence as a product of climate and structure, the expected cost and futility of speaking and the absence of a route, rather than of individual courage or skill
text.es: Diagnosticar el silencio organizativo como producto del clima y de la estructura, el coste y la inutilidad esperados de hablar y la falta de un cauce, y no de la valentía o la habilidad individuales

text.en: Distinguish transparency of process and information from transparency of people, and predict when each raises or suppresses candour
text.es: Distinguir la transparencia de procesos e información de la transparencia sobre las personas, y predecir cuándo cada una aumenta o reprime la franqueza

text.en: Design zones of privacy that protect learning and dissent without removing the record where it matters most
text.es: Diseñar zonas de privacidad que protejan el aprendizaje y la discrepancia sin eliminar el registro allí donde más importa

text.en: Build peer-feedback and decision-weighting systems with calibration, bias audit, appeal and accountable ownership, and respond to the first data-backed challenge to them
text.es: Construir sistemas de evaluación entre pares y de ponderación de decisiones con calibración, auditoría de sesgos, apelación y un responsable claro, y responder al primer cuestionamiento respaldado por datos

text.en: Recommend upward to a founder, with evidence, a staged path and a stop condition he did not ask for
text.es: Recomendar al fundador, con evidencia, un camino por etapas y una condición de parada que él no había pedido

name.en: Keeping points on nerve to stay aligned with the founder
name.es: Dejar puntos en el valor para seguir alineado con el fundador

lure.en: The founder has already put 70 of 100 points on nerve, and agreeing with him protects his backing in the first week
lure.es: El fundador ya ha puesto 70 de 100 puntos en el valor, y coincidir con él protege su respaldo la primera semana

consequence.en: Diagnosis points are lost and every later escalation gain is scaled down, because the design treats people rather than the cost of speaking and the missing route
consequence.es: Se pierden puntos de diagnóstico y se reduce cada mejora posterior del escalado, porque el diseño trata a las personas y no el coste de hablar ni la falta de ruta

source.ref: TN §13 (agreeing with the founder in Round 1), §7 Q1 likely positions, TN-Exhibit 1

name.en: Judging the programme by ratings and issues logged
name.es: Juzgar el programa por las puntuaciones y las incidencias registradas

lure.en: Activity on the record rises as soon as the tools go live, so the counter shows progress at once and the founder likes it
lure.es: La actividad registrada sube en cuanto se activan las herramientas, así que el contador muestra progreso enseguida y al fundador le gusta

consequence.en: People perform for the counter: hiding rises, the effectiveness of every escalation gain falls and the metric earns no process credit
consequence.es: La gente actúa para el contador: aumenta la ocultación, baja la eficacia de cada mejora del escalado y la métrica no suma puntos de proceso

source.ref: TN §13 (counting activity), §7 Q1, §9.2 (the measurement trap), TN-Exhibit 1

name.en: Launching the founder's full design company-wide
name.es: Lanzar el diseño completo del fundador en toda la empresa

lure.en: It is the founder's plan, it keeps his backing high and its week-2 readout looks better than a process-first pilot
lure.es: Es el plan del fundador, mantiene alto su respaldo y la lectura de la semana 2 parece mejor que la de un piloto centrado en procesos

consequence.en: At the week-10 pulse safety collapses, regretted attrition and exposure rise and real disagreement moves to private messages; the lag carries into the final score
consequence.es: En el pulso de la semana 10 la seguridad se hunde, suben la rotación no deseada y la exposición y la discrepancia real se va a mensajes privados; el retraso pesa en la nota final

source.ref: TN §7 Q2 (the week-2 illusion), §13 (celebrating week 2), §5.5, TN-Exhibit 4

name.en: Suspending the rating app when it is challenged with data
name.es: Suspender la app de puntuaciones cuando se la cuestiona con datos

lure.en: The VP Engineering wants it off and it feels like the responsible move while the bias is investigated
lure.es: El VP de Ingeniería quiere apagarla y parece lo responsable mientras se investiga el sesgo

consequence.en: Everyone learns that candour aimed upward gets the tool switched off: the largest safety shock of the round, chilled escalation and lost founder backing
consequence.es: Todos aprenden que la franqueza dirigida hacia arriba hace que se apague la herramienta: el mayor golpe a la seguridad de la ronda, un escalado frenado y menos respaldo del fundador

source.ref: TN §7 Q4 likely positions, §13 (treating the dispute as PR), TN-Exhibits 3 and 5

name.en: Taking launch go/no-go meetings off the record
name.es: Sacar del registro las reuniones de aprobación de lanzamientos

lure.en: After the transparency paradox, privacy everywhere feels protective, and juniors may speak more freely without a record
lure.es: Tras la paradoja de la transparencia, la privacidad en todas partes parece protectora, y los perfiles júnior podrían hablar con más libertad sin registro

consequence.en: The one meeting where Quaybook was approved without minutes loses its record again: most of the benefit of recording and of logging dissent there goes, and safety falls
consequence.es: La única reunión donde se aprobó Quaybook sin acta vuelve a quedarse sin registro: se pierde casi todo el beneficio de grabar y de registrar la discrepancia allí, y baja la seguridad

en: took go/no-go meetings off the record
